description: Create or upsert one spatial entity (position, orientation, AABB, tags, properties, confidence). Manual authoring only. Omit id to create (ULID assigned). Provide id to update. Omitted fields are preserved; this is a partial merge, not a full replace. status defaults to active. confidence is 0.0–1.0 object-permanence. Does not ingest vision detections or apply action results. Returns {ok, entity_id, created:boolean, entity}. Use update_entity instead of ingest_observation when authoring entities directly rather than merging perception detections.

confidence.description: Object permanence confidence score from 0.0 to 1.0 (default: 1.0)

id.description: Optional entity ID (auto-generated ULID if omitted for creation)

name.description: Human-readable name or label of the entity

parent_id.description: Optional parent entity ID for hierarchical containment or attachments

properties.description: Arbitrary JSON key-value properties (physics, materials, interactive state)

region_id.description: Optional named region ID where this entity resides

velocity.description: 3D velocity vector (vx, vy, vz) for physical motion and predictive permanence

name: update_entity
